messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Beta test 0.73
parts:
Hello,

Should you choose to, you may beta test 0.73

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/unstable/code/Rhipe_0.73.tar.gz?raw=true

I am using this daily, so your bugs will be fixed quickly :)

Cheers
Saptarshi

Note, rhwrite has changed in 0.73. See ?rhwrite

One nice feature for testing: rhJobInfo which takes the job id returns the timing information of all the tasks.
0.73 has improved MapFile performance and rhread is much faster.

If you have comments about the R help pages, send recommendations. They will be incorporated.
This is currently in the 'unstable' branch but hopefully by end of Feb, middle March it will be stable.

0.74 will remove the custom R binary and will be entirely in rJava, JRI and some C code. Installation should hopefully be simpler, though you'll still need to compile with protobuf!

Cheers
Saptarshi

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: Beta test 0.73
parts:
Hi
Good question.I wish i could you give you a sensible answer ...
I have no %#E% idea what the answer is.  That said, i have a feeling it is allowed and will work.

RHIPEs license can always change to make things work nicer.
So if you have legal hurdles before using RHIPE, i recommend one consult a lawyer or a knowledgeable person.

The move to JRI is speed. I have already seen really positive speed improvements, in that RHIPE adds very small overhead.


Cheers
Saptarshi
